name: Antisuns
detailed_description:
Antisuns is a tactical sci-fi RPG.

Command Your Crew in Turn-Based Battles Across Multiple Spaceships

  • Anticipate enemy moves and develop the perfect response.

  • Take risks to earn greater rewards.

  • If you fail, rewind time to start a new, randomly generated run.

Always On the Run

  • Your unique Jump Drive allows you to instantly traverse incredible distances and even rewind time itself.

  • No wonder every faction in the galaxy is after you.

  • They will stop at nothing to defeat you and capture the Jump Drive.

  • You can’t stay in one place too long while pursuing your ultimate goal: the safety of your home planet.

Board Enemy Ships and Engage in Complex Tactical Combat

  • To escape, you need to bring the fight to the enemy.

  • Send your boarding crew onto the enemy ship.

  • Eliminate all resistance as you progress through the ship in turn-based combat.

  • Support your boarding crew with your own ship’s cannons.

  • Fight on two fronts, as you simultaneously fend off enemy boarding parties.

Anticipate Opponent Moves and Devise the Perfect Counter

  • You can always see what the enemy characters plan to do next.

  • Use this knowledge to perfectly plan your moves.

  • You can rewind your own moves as often as you like, allowing you to experiment with various ideas until you find the best solution.

Face Countless Unique Challenges in Each Run

  • Failure is never final.

  • Simply rewind time and try again.

  • Antisuns offers endless replayability, with each playthrough presenting new, randomly generated challenges.

Assemble Your Team Exactly How You Want

  • Each character class has a unique skill tree.

  • Level up your characters and try out their new abilities.

  • Combine classes to form a unique squad of seasoned fighters.

short_description: Antisuns is a tactical RPG set in the far future. Command your crew in turn-based ship-to-ship boarding actions. See enemy moves ahead of time to solve each battle like a deadly puzzle. Push your luck for greater rewards. If you fail, rewind time for another randomly-generated run.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E4700 2.6 GHz or AMD Phenom 9950 Quad Core 2.6 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB ATI Radeon HD 5770, 1GB NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
